cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

mechanism: A assumes authority over where an exhausted partner may rest, minimizing a practical household problem while personally absorbing its work.
confusable: D15 protects feelings from a hurtful truth; D39 hides a practical burden out of kindness, which must be visible in the help A supplies.
comparison: An exhausted ward worker is shielded from upstairs water damage; the bike alternative shields an afternoon off from fragmented repairs.
seedUse: D39-a already uses deferred questions and directed resting arrangements to make superior control the form of practical care.
